chunks: Except the chosen ones among them.
ai.seo_question: Who are the 'Mukhlasin' (chosen ones) in Shia supplications?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'al-mukhṣaṣīn' (the purified/special ones) is frequently interpreted as referring to the Ahl al-Bayt, particularly Imam Ali and the Imams, who possess innate spiritual purity (Ismah). This phrase highlights their unique status as the exclusive intermediaries of divine grace, distinguishing them from the general populace who may be righteous but lack this specific, divinely chosen closeness.
